inspiration: Icons ship at 1x and at 2x with nearest-neighbour scaling (public/landing-icons/README), so pixel edges stay hard on phones. Our icon set can use the same rule.

Item icons follow a strict naming rule per category (etc_, weapon_, armor_ plus an index), mapped from the group tables by a script (scripts/audit/map-item-icons-grp.ts). Thousands of icons stay addressable by code.
The data pipeline is raw tables to parser to committed JSON, regenerated only when a parser changes (README, Local development). Good model for our item and spawn data.
Zone geometry (regions, huntingzones) and spawns are separate tables in data/generated/interlude/. Keep the map shape and the spawn list apart.
Shops, crafting and dye are data tables (buylists, multisells, recipes, hennas). One generic shop-table shape can serve many shops.

The landing-page icon names suggest a small set of emblem motifs (a flower-tipped spear, a worn blade, a single-eye monster, a compass, a gatekeeper). These are concepts to redraw from scratch, not names to reuse.
